body:
## Scope

**Heuristic; credited synthesis; general moment asymptotic unproved.**

This completes the openly scoped leading-term heuristic for the displayed Dirichlet-product example in AIM Problem 5.3: finitely many fixed unshifted Dirichlet characters, arbitrary fixed moduli, and fixed nonnegative real weights. It retains primitive-inducer multiplicities, every deleted Euler factor, and the Barnes-G normalization. The principal models are credited to Keating--Snaith, Heap and Sahay. No new mathematical priority is claimed.

The `claimed_solved` queue label refers only to this heuristic request. The critical-line moment asymptotic and modeling assumptions remain conjectural. Negative powers, shifted/unbalanced moments, growing-modulus/weight uniformity, all lower-order terms, and universal higher-degree claims are excluded.

## Contents and checks

- Preserve 23 frozen research files byte for byte: 11 author files, 11 review files, and the clarification addendum.
- Add a current-scope entrypoint, publication state/manifest, and an isolated replay verifier.
- Independent AI-assisted review accepted the scoped heuristic; all three nonblocking clarifications are included. This is not human peer review.
- Fresh author replay: 966 reported checks, byte-identical output. Fresh independent reviewer replay: 380 cases, byte-identical output. Counts use different conventions and do not prove actual high moments.
- `python3 verify_publication.py --replay` passes. Public tree blob hashes verified against local bytes.
- Only this target's queue Status, Turns and scope-qualified Findings cells change; all existing links, header bytes, and other rows remain untouched.

Read [the current entrypoint](unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000693/README.md), [the heuristic](unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000693/author/HEURISTIC.md), and [the independent review](unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000693/review/REVIEW.md).

External PDFs/HTML, full source-text extractions, and imported corpora are excluded. Author turns remain **1/5**. No merge, release, DOI or external outreach is requested.
title: 20000693: reviewed Dirichlet-product moment heuristic (1/5)
